 HoopsHype Nov. 18, 2026, 5:23 p.m. ET Abby Jones: Yaxel Lendeborg spoke on playing against Morez Johnson Jr. and Dusty May for the first time in his NBA Career. "I know they ran one play that we did last year, so I'm gonna probably try to cheat that up later on. I'm just gonna be very excited to see those guys. I actually got to share a little moment with them before we got on the court. Just knowing [May's] game plan and how it was in college, I don't think it's the same because we're in the pros now. Just going out there trying to play my game -- I've developed a little bit more, so maybe he doesn't have the same scouting report he did last year. Hopefully that plays to my benefit. I know how Morez [Johnson Jr.] plays for sure, from head to toe, so I'm gonna be able to call that out. I don't know what Dusty has got in store for me tonight.
